title: France's Macron and Japan's Takaichi give nod to 'Dragon Ball' franchise
summary: On a visit to #Japan, French President Emmanuel #Macron shared a 'kamehameha' moment with PM Sanae #Takaichi - a nod to one of Japan's most famous #manga and #anime franchises, 'Dragon Ball'. Macron is on a state visit to #Tokyo for talks on security ties and industrial cooperation.
